'''Ulfor Bombaasa'''<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]]<ref name="ROTS" /> who was present outside the [[Galaxies Opera House]] in the [[Uscru District]] of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> during a performance of the [[opera]] ''[[Squid Lake]]''.<ref name="USW" /> Bombaasa was walking up the steps of the opera house with<ref name="ROTS" /> the [[alien]] [[Opula Deget]] behind [[Duke]] [[Teta (duke)|Teta]] and the [[Twi'lek]] [[Koyi Mateil]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> when the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] ran passed them on his way to meet with [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. Bombaasa had fair skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="ROTS" /> He wore a black fur-trimmed [[Clothing|coat]] with a light purple [[silk]] shirt and gold sash along with a pair of black [[boot]]s.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ulfor Bombaasa was portrayed by [[James McBryde]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> James McBryde also had previously appeared as an unnamed extra in Dex's Diner in ''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones''. The character's name was first revealed by the reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', which was written by [[Trisha Biggar]] and released on [[October 1]], 2005. The name was then used in [[canon]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> a reference book released on [[April 4]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-galaxy-guides-get-a-first-look-at-dks-star-wars-visual-encyclopedia-and-the-amazing-book-of-lego-star-wars|text=New Galaxy Guides: Get a First Look at DK's ''Star Wars Visual Encyclopedia'' and ''The Amazing Book of LEGO Star Wars''}}</ref>
